name: Custom Block With Forever
hint: If a custom block contains a [sbi]forever[/sbi] loop and the custom block is used in the middle of another script, the script will never be able to finish.[newLine]The [sbi]forever[/sbi] loop in the custom block cannot be left, resulting in the calling script never being able to proceed.
instruction: Delete the [sbi]forever[/sbi] loop from your custom block.

examples.label: Error
examples.scratchblocks:
define longMarch
forever :: #ff0000 //⇦  🐛
move (10) steps
end

when green flag clicked
longMarch
say [Hello!] //⇦  🐛

examples.label: Possible Solution
examples.scratchblocks:
define longMarch
repeat (10) //⇦  👍
move (10) steps
end

when green flag clicked
longMarch
say [Hello!]
